name: FACTBENCH
description: FACTBENCH is a dataset of 1,000 prompts across 150 fine-grained topics designed to evaluate language model factuality in real-world interactions. It captures emerging factuality challenges by categorizing LM-generated content as supported, unsupported, or undecidable based on web-retrieved evidence.
reputation: A small but useful factuality benchmark that has attracted interest for evaluating real-world hallucination behavior, though it is not yet a widely standardized leader-board benchmark.
notes: Dataset is regularly updatable and benchmarks multiple LMs including GPT, Gemini, and Llama families.
